spans.s:
√sphur or sphṛ (sphuráti, -te; áspharīt;
sphuritá). make a quick or jerky
motion:
 —1. dart, trans.; with the foot,
kick;
 —2. dart, intrans.; twitch (of the
eye, arm);
 —3. (of the lightning) flash.
[for *spṛ, ‘quiver, jerk, kick, flutter’:
cf. ἀ-σπαίρ-ω, ‘struggle convulsively’ (as
a fish just out of water); Lat. spernere,
‘kiek away, reject’; Eng. spur, ‘goad
with the heel’; spurn, ‘kick away’: see
also under parṇa.]
+ pra, shake, tremble.
